s1.syndrome_frame: Acute onset of headache and vision loss with sinus inflammation
salient_findings: Severe headache with worsening over time
Opacification of all sinuses on the right with diffuse inflammation
Bony erosion of the medial orbital apex bone
key_facts: Patient is a man in his 70s
No history of chronic or allergic rhinosinusitis
Recent diagnosis of COVID-19
Rhinorrhea three weeks prior to presentation
Headache for 2 weeks
Vision loss in the right eye for 2 days
Severe pain on ocular motion
Right eye visual acuity limited to hand-motion detection
Opacification of all sinuses on the right with diffuse inflammation on CT
Bony erosion of the medial orbital apex bone with extension of inflammation into the apex
Positive sinus cultures for Streptococcus constellatus
Elevated Serum IgG4 levels
